questions.question: On this day in 1926, which English author published the classic children's book 'Winnie-the-Pooh', illustrated by E. H. Shepard?
questions.explanation: Milne created the beloved bear Winnie-the-Pooh in a collection of stories first published on 14 October 1926.
questions.context:
On this day in 1926: The first book featuring English author A. A. Milne's fictional bear Winnie-the-Pooh was published.
Winnie-the-Pooh (book) (1926 book by A. A. Milne): Winnie-the-Pooh is a 1926 children's book by English author A. A. Milne and English illustrator E. H. Shepard.

questions.question: Which 2010 western film served as the breakthrough screen performance for Hailee Steinfeld, earning her an Academy Award nomination?
questions.explanation: Steinfeld rose to prominence with her role in the 2010 adaptation of True Grit, which earned her widespread critical acclaim and an Oscar nomination.
questions.context: Hailee Steinfeld (American actress and singer (born 1996)): Hailee Steinfeld is an American actress and singer. She had her breakthrough with the western film True Grit (2010), which earned her various accolades, including nominations for an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a Critics' Choice Movie Award and an Actor Award.

questions.question: In the critically acclaimed drama Breaking Bad, what is the familial relationship between the hitmen Marco and Leonel Salamanca, played by Luis and Daniel Moncada?
questions.explanation: Known on the show as 'The Cousins', the Salamanca hitmen are twin brothers, although in reality actor Luis Moncada is three years older than Daniel.
questions.context: Daniel and Luis Moncada (Honduran-American actors (born 1980 and 1977)): Daniel Moncada and Luis Moncada are Honduran actors and brothers best known for their role as "The Cousins" Leonel and Marco Salamanca on the award-winning AMC crime drama series Breaking Bad (2008–2013) and its spin-off Better Call Saul (2015–2022). Despite playing twins on television, Luis is the elder brother by three years.

questions.question: Which organic chemical compound, classified as a cyclic monoterpene, is responsible for the main scent in citrus fruit peels?
questions.explanation: Limonene is an aliphatic hydrocarbon that derives its name from the Italian word for lemon and constitutes the primary aroma component in citrus peels.
questions.context: Limonene (Type of molecule): Limonene is a slightly yellow-green liquid aliphatic hydrocarbon classified as a cyclic monoterpene, and is the major component in the fragrance and essential oil of citrus fruit peels, taking its name from Italian limone 'lemon'.

questions.question: Which NFL franchise drafted quarterback Josh Allen seventh overall in the 2018 draft following his collegiate career with Reedley and Wyoming?
questions.explanation: Allen was drafted seventh overall by the Buffalo Bills in 2018 and became known as one of the league's top dual-threat quarterbacks.
questions.context: Josh Allen (American football player (born 1996)): Joshua Patrick Allen is an American professional football quarterback for the Buffalo Bills of the National Football League (NFL). He is regarded as one of the greatest dual-threat quarterbacks of all time and is the NFL leader in quarterback rushing touchdowns. A lightly recruited high school prospect, Allen began his college football career with the Reedley Tigers before transferring to the Wyoming Cowboys. He was selected seventh overall by the Bills in the 2018 NFL draft.
